title: Sketchpad Kit Hook Refactor
description: Implement kit data path: sketchpad only compose/react hooks; react only compose/js stores; js only KitStoreHandle.execute to Rust; all kit mutations semantic commands; no sketchpad manual diff/patch.
summary: Sketchpad uses only @semio-tech/compose-react for kit I/O; registry context notifies consumers on open/close; useOpenKitShallows/useRegistry* hooks; attachSketchpadKitReadShell + patchQuality + runKitStoreHandleExecute in js; removed kit shallow cache; re-exports asKitInstance/importKitToPlain.
